lines: Lane b-client-investing (B8), branch track/b-client-investing from main 47d82a6. Commits: 5c73eeb (flag gating + History), 1e4861a (printable statement), e9751cf (rule-11 copy fix). Review follow-ups: 4699830 (History lists every unsettled online payment), f614152 (portfolio empty state), b6e686c (screen test), e4f427f (statement scroller a11y). Not landed, not pushed.

SCOPE CHANGE mid-lane (maintainer, rule-11, relayed by the coordinator 2026-11-13): no How to invest card, no FAQ or support link for investing, no copy on how or where to pay. The card was built, then removed before commit; it never reached a commit. G11 is now only: the maintainer publishes featureFlags.onlinePayments=false after this lands.

Flag: features/investing/onlinePayments.ts. readOnlinePaymentsOff(config) is true only when config.featureFlags.onlinePayments === false. useOnlinePaymentsOff() reads useAppConfigFeed(false). Absent, loading, failed, null config or a non-boolean value all keep today's behaviour.

Gated when the flag is off: FundDetail Invest a lump sum and Start a SIP (replaced by one neutral line); LumpsumInvestScreen and SipStartScreen deep links render PaymentsOffPage (neutral line + See my portfolio); SipDetail Set up AutoPay again (hidden; AutoPay explanation says it is not collecting); PaymentStatus Try again on payment_failed (hidden); SipList, Activity and Portfolio empty states drop Browse funds and the invest prompt.

History (flag off): Activity drops both tab rows. The ledger list stays in place inside LedgerPanel. Below it, OnlinePaymentHistory (was NotCompletedPayments) reads the existing 'all' payments filter under the same query key as ActivityScreen's usePayments('all'). It walks every page with a guarded effect that stops on a failed page (loadAll would re-fire after each failure) and lists every payment with status != confirmed. payment_in_progress reads Not completed; the rest keep clientInvestmentStatus labels; each row links to /activity/payments/:id. A read failure shows the standard error with retry. Section title: 'Online payments'; its copy says to contact Support with the reference, with no payment instructions.
PaymentStatus treats payment_in_progress as Not completed while off, with copy that makes no claim about charges. Closes finding-23 with no contract change.

Print: /statements/print (chrome none, back to /statements). It is a table with the holder name, preparation date and MoneyFootnote. Print statement on StatementsScreen and the Print button (window.print) render only when !isNative(). The table scroller is a focusable labelled region. Print rules are in features/statements/statements.recipe.ts.

e9751cf copy fix: domain/failure.ts PAY_TEAM_DIRECTLY becomes RECORDED_INVESTMENTS_STILL_SHOW in 5 payments-off messages. SipDetail manual explanation, Paid by ('You, each month') and SipStart manual hint changed. Copy only.

Shared files: ActivityScreen (payment row moved to activity/PaymentCard.tsx; ledger TabPanel wrapped by LedgerPanel; ledger rows untouched so b-receipts links apply in both modes), clientRoutes (statement-print route; link map statements: [statement-print]), domain/failure.ts, PortfolioScreen (empty state only). Heads-ups note-36 and note-37 posted.

Tests: onlinePayments.test.tsx (10: flag semantics through react-query, including failed and loading reads) and paymentsOffScreens.test.tsx (4: lump-sum and SIP forms with the flag false versus absent).

Checks (Node 22 container, after e4f427f): contracts npm ci + build passed. frontend npm run check passed (typecheck, lint, vitest 29 files/255 tests, drift, build, boot check, phonepe-native-target). build:client passed (android dist 17 assets).

Negative controls: flag test failed 2/10 with absent treated as off and 3/10 with failed/loading treated as off. Screen test failed 2/4 (both flag-off cases) when the wrappers ignored the flag. All files restored.

Not verified: no browser or APK run. Print layout and page breaks were not seen. The native hardware Back prompt on the invest routes still asks 'Leave without investing?' over PaymentsOffPage (shell-owned, untouched). The existing usePagedQuery loadAll re-fires fetchNextPage after a failed page (affects useFundCatalogue); not changed here.

APK statement plan (not built): Android WebView has no print dialog. Option A (frontend only, interim): open <web app>/statements/print in the system browser via the installed @capacitor/browser. The client signs in again there (separate client_web session), and the URL needs B6 CLIENT_WEB_APP_URL. Option B (recommended): a new GET /v1/client/statements/{period}/document that returns a server-rendered PDF, opened through a short-lived signed download link in @capacitor/browser or shared via a new Filesystem/Share plugin (plugin allowlist change and an APK release). Option B needs backend, contract and maintainer approval.

Known gap: while off, failed, refunded, refund-in-progress and needs-review online payments are not listed in Activity. They stay reachable through notifications and /activity/payments/:id. Listing them needs a multi-status query; http.ts buildQuery has no array support and the contract enum refuses a comma-joined string.
